full_judgment: 13. Admittedly, respondent No. 1 is a line manufacturing factory in which Titas Gas gave its connection under particular agreement, rules and regulations. Record reveals that Titas Gas instituted Money Suit No. 5 of 1998 in the First Court of Joint District Judge, Narayanganj for realization of arrear gas bills. The learned Joint District Judge, First Court, Narayanganj, decreed the suit in part for an amount of Taka 1,90,489.44. Against the said judgment and decree, Titas Gas preferred First Appeal No.164 of 2007 which is pending. Upon obtaining arrear determined amount of Taka 1,90,489.44, Titas Gas restored the gas connection to respondent No. 1. Respondents No.1 alleged that the functionaries of Titas Gas at the time of restoration of gas connection obtained the disputed agreement from the proprietor of respondent No. 1 on 18-1-2003 by coercion, intimidation and threat for not restoring the gas connection.
